reviews.title: Infuriating to Use - would never pay for this
reviews.text:
I started using this app because Spotify stopped offering the podcast I listen to.  For starters, the Home Screen is a cluttered mess and it takes a minute to get situated every time I open the app.

I like to download a dozen or so episodes at a time so that I can listen offline.  But for some reason, when I am offline the episodes don’t load because there is no connection.  The whole point of downloading them is that they are on my phone and available whenever. Clearly nothing is actually downloaded.
Play back has  issues as well.  The app RARELY saves the mark of my last listen, offline/online/wifi/Cell.  I open the app and it starts playing from some random place and then I have to skip ahead until I get to where I actually am.  The bar on the player that tracks the current time is hard to actually grab and drag to skip ahead quickly.
When the episode I’m listening to is done, the app doesn’t go to the next downloaded episode in my list.  Instead it starts playing the next episode in the podcast’s episode list, whether it has been downloaded or not.

Maybe these issues go away if you use the paid version, but my user experience is so poor that why would I waste money on this.

reviews.text: IHeart boasts of making all NFL games available, but is unprepared to handle the demands of that. Currently, WDVE (Pittsburgh) is nonresponsive, while KDKA (also Pittsburgh, but not carrying the game) and KVET and KASE (Austin) have no problem.

reviews.title: Huge disservice to the actual stations
reviews.text: Love some of the shows you can listen to. However, listening live to any station is spotty at best. You start getting spammed with all of the ads and if you stop and play again, then it goes back into the radio station, but the app eventually learns that you’re doing that and makes you listen to old songs from early 2000s and you know that because if you stop and play it restarts the song. It will also play ads in different languages, even though you set your preferred language in the app and I have reached out to the help department to get it fixed and they have done nothing. It is really sad because I know that customers have reached out to some of the radio stations and DJs asking for help with us they have sent the complaints to their bosses and nothing gets done about it, but the spamming of ads is way out of hand. I get that you have to have ads to make it free, but when you have ads so much that you can’t even listen to the actual station, you’re trying to listen to, it’s crazy. Plus, they run the ads mid sentence of someone talking and then when you go back to relisten in the podcast version still the ad cuts them off mid sentence.

reviews.title: Fan turning to other options
reviews.text:
Long time user, first time caller. I used to be a fan of iHeartRadio because I lived in places like North Dakota, southern Illinois, and even in the heart of Ohio where I needed a tool or a resource better than a local radio stations. I first used it in 2014 in England to get tapped in to U.S. stations. Now I live in Hampton Roads, Virginia, within the last 2-3 months, this app has changed drastically. 

Starting up: This app takes an unreasonably amount of time in upwards of a minute or two. 

CarPlay: It must be the most recent update but there is a consistent blank screen when I try to access CarPlay. The point is to not utilize your phone while you’re driving right? Not this puppy. Blank screen on the dash. Got to wipe out the phone….and guess what? Now I have to wait for that to load as well. 

Connecting to/switching stations: 
Even on home WiFi, the delay and lag, noticeably awkward. 
In the truck, more of the same especially when I’m in great 5UW cell bands. 

The Positive: 
I am proud NGEN radio is a station!!! Definitely “favorited”! This is the sole reason I’m keep this app downloaded. Otherwise I can learn to tolerate the NGEN app and is lagging. 

Resolve these issues, and you’re a solid 4 star. Prevent them from happening/disturbing the experience, and you rank an easy 5.
